summary: Make console image quality presets take effect by enabling QEMU VNC lossy encoding and refreshing the framebuffer when the preset changes.

guide.reason: Quality control behaviour and host-console limitation are described for operators.

api.reason: Console WebSocket and ticket contracts are unchanged; only QEMU VNC encoding options and the browser client presets change.

state.record: VM domain XML emulator path (/usr/lib/nex/qemu-vnc-lossy) on the pool master host
state.reason: Lossy VNC is a host-side QEMU display option stored in the libvirt domain definition; a fresh Controller re-adopts the same domain from the host.

verification.method: go test ./internal/vmhost/ -count=1 -run 'QEMUVNC|LossyVNC|ManagedReferencesAndXML|ManagedDomainXML' and npm run typecheck in web/; both passed.
verification.limits: Visual quality difference against a live QEMU guest with lossy=on not re-walked in this change; requires a redefined/restarted VM on an updated Core host.
